Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 129. Category: technique. Rank 4.

Rank 4 melee technique
Ki Cost: 50 Ki
Prerequisites: Piercing Punch
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Melee
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Instantaneous (Special)
Strike your foe and either shatter their armor or cut
their ki connection to their defenses.
Make a combo attack rolls dealing your unarmed
strike damage on a hit. You also remove one of the
following from the target’s AC calculation.
Armor bonus
Wisdom Modifier
Constitution Modifier
This effect lasts for 1 minute or until the armor is
repaired by someone.
